title: Relocked Builder Extended Rate Lock — Lapse Days in Extensions
content:
A Builder Extended Rate Lock that has been relocked carries extra days into any later extension, measured from its expired date.

**Standard.** A lock that has been relocked and whose expired date lies more than 14 calendar days before the extension adds 2 days to the days to cover; a lock that has been relocked and whose expired date lies 14 or fewer calendar days before the extension adds 1 day; any other lock adds none. The days are added before the days to cover are rounded up to whole increments.

## Records read

- Whether the lock has been relocked: the relocks used count on the lock record, one or more.
- The expired date: the expired date on the lock record.
- The extension date: the date the extension is written.

## Both sides of 14 days

| Lock relocked | Calendar days from the expired date to the extension date | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 14 or fewer | 1 |
| Yes | 15 or more | 2 |
| No | any | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Expired date 10 March, relocked, extension written 24 March: 14 days, adds 1.
- Same lock, extension written 25 March: 15 days, adds 2.
- A lock never relocked adds none, whatever its history.
